hero.title: Computer Engineer
hero.lead: Computer Engineer with over 9 years of professional experience in the analysis, design, development, implementation and maintenance of information systems at higher education and healthcare institutions.
hero.body: Experience in Full Stack development, technical leadership, IT project coordination, systems integration, process automation, and software quality and security assurance.
hero.closing: Holder of a <es>Diplomado en Gestión y Dirección de Proyectos TI</es> (IT project management) from Duoc UC and a <es>Diploma de Postítulo en Ciberseguridad</es> (postgraduate cybersecurity diploma) from Universidad de Chile, with a professional outlook that integrates software engineering, technology leadership and information security.

about.title: Engineering, leadership and security
about.p1: I am a Computer Engineer with over 9 years of experience in the analysis, development and maintenance of institutional systems in higher education and healthcare.
about.p2: I have worked on the technical coordination of development projects, requirements gathering, software solution implementation, systems integration, testing, technical documentation and quality assurance.
about.p3: I have trained in IT project management, Scrum, PMBOK, information security, risk management, ISMS, ISO/IEC 27001 and 27002, personal data protection and Chilean cybersecurity regulations.
about.linesIntro: My professional focus brings together three lines of work:
